s1-002-3e05eab713bc5695.wav.text: Today, a fact about attention that should bother you more than it usually does: self-attention has no idea what order the tokens are in.

s1-004-c78e8f012ca8c90a.wav.text: And then the three standard ways of telling it, and the one that won, derived from the property it was designed to have rather than presented as a formula to memorise.

s10-002-0553f58b2d4178f8.wav.text: Self-attention is permutation-equivariant, so word order has to be supplied from outside, and a causal decoder gets a weak version of it for free by counting.

s10-004-c5aa5be8eec8b3a6.wav.text: RoPE falls out of a single wish — that the score should depend only on the gap — and the resulting identity holds to one point eight times ten to the minus fifteen, which is exactly, not approximately.

s10-006-df8847b7058a811a.wav.text: It wins on loss, costs nothing in parameters, and is the only one of the three that still has an answer past the training length.

s10-007-db7c8e338ed817a4.wav.text: Next time, we train the whole model and then go looking for what it learned.

s10-008-e2802b71f7e18418.wav.text: Including an experiment that gave us a beautiful result which turned out to be completely wrong.

s2-002-33a7f32c0e88c15a.wav.text: Shuffle the input tokens and the outputs come out shuffled the same way, otherwise unchanged.

s2-003-0fb5c9c6f1636b6d.wav.text: Every operation inside it — the dot products, the softmax, the weighted sum — treats the sequence as a bag of vectors.

s2-004-59017d079e93f799.wav.text: Nothing in that arithmetic distinguishes buy one hundred INFY from one hundred INFY buy.

s2-005-239bc7eebffe1a42.wav.text: So position has to be bolted on, and there are three standard bolts.

s2-006-3e9c899ebfd58a88.wav.text: One, learned: a trained vector for each absolute slot, added to the token embedding.

s2-008-739055dea2c89eb1.wav.text: Two, sinusoidal: a fixed table of sines and cosines at geometrically spaced frequencies, also added.

s2-010-31e668553f6f56bf.wav.text: Three, rotary — RoPE — which rotates the query and key vectors themselves, inside every attention layer.

s2-011-4f67c89251bfac54.wav.text: And the structural difference to hold on to is *where* they act.

s2-012-df603a91886bae92.wav.text: The first two edit the residual stream once, at the bottom.

s2-013-15bd76b7766e2b4e.wav.text: The third never touches the residual stream at all.

s3-000-b4aebe6ff152c452.wav.text: Now instead of presenting RoPE, let us derive it, because it is one of those ideas that is obvious once the question is written down correctly.

s3-001-b8233873218e173e.wav.text: Start from what a score actually wants.

s3-002-e8f6e95ba1c3f096.wav.text: It should depend on the *relationship* between two positions, not their absolute indices.

s3-003-17ca0d069ad017ce.wav.text: The token three back is a useful thing to encode.

s3-004-ba325508a9af8f7f.wav.text: The token at index one thousand and forty seven is not.

s3-005-acc5d2711bf8163a.wav.text: So write that wish as an equation: the inner product of f of q at position m with f of k at position n should equal some function g of q, k, and m minus n.

s3-007-fd1d697b90b517a2.wav.text: Now ask what f could possibly be.

s3-008-d559587a6a85dd81.wav.text: In two dimensions the answer arrives immediately: a rotation.

s3-009-8d9b07f4efca91c8.wav.text: Rotations compose by adding angles, and the inner product is invariant under rotating both vectors together.

s3-010-ab6682aa0add0bcb.wav.text: So rotate q by m theta and k by n theta, and their dot product depends only on m minus n times theta.

s3-012-77fa1296462b1bc0.wav.text: RoPE is not a trick somebody found by trial and error.

s3-013-e2fce5174a4ca4cb.wav.text: It is the unique simple answer to a question that was written down properly.

s4-000-8f6e07ffd6152f1f.wav.text: Here is that identity written three ways.

s4-001-8030f32563bee8c9.wav.text: In English: rotate the query by its position and the key by its position, and the score depends only on the distance between them, not on where either one sits.

s4-002-110c7906c7ed3630.wav.text: In symbols: the inner product of R m q with R n k equals the inner product of R m minus n q with R zero k.

s4-003-4402fb9675782a82.wav.text: And in code, which is how you check it rather than believe it.

s4-004-de3a0dcb9b644ba1.wav.text: We evaluate both sides on random vectors in float sixty four, over head dimensions from two to sixty four, for positive and negative gaps.

s4-005-5fb407a8eef79f92.wav.text: The largest disagreement is one point eight times ten to the minus fifteen.

s4-006-6d246048cf642b38.wav.text: That is float sixty four round-off.

s4-007-d39e75873c163b00.wav.text: It is not an approximation that happens to hold well.

s4-008-9b0a990a0b2b72cf.wav.text: It is an identity, and it holds exactly.

s5-000-aa547309da5072ec.wav.text: A d-dimensional head is d over two independent two-dimensional rotations, each at its own angular rate.

s5-001-c481e997f3b704c7.wav.text: Here is the ladder for a head of width sixteen.

s5-002-f41af683d0b8fd99.wav.text: Pair zero turns fastest: its wavelength is six point three positions, so it comes back round to where it started every six tokens.

s5-005-3c31bd5df6ab94fc.wav.text: Pair three, one hundred and ninety nine.

s5-006-c5de358fe3c8471f.wav.text: Think of them as clock hands at different speeds, and a position as the full set of hand angles — which is a binary counter wearing continuous clothing.

s5-007-aa513c28d219c40d.wav.text: The fast hands resolve neighbours: they tell one token from the next.

s5-008-5c256c5a1ec23f9c.wav.text: The slow hands have wavelengths far longer than the context, so within a document they behave as a coarse "roughly where am I" signal.

s5-009-920650450c8bd514.wav.text: And that ladder, ten thousand to the minus two i over d, is exactly the ladder in the original sinusoidal table.

s5-010-7101c231597e4771.wav.text: RoPE is the same frequency scheme applied as a rotation instead of as an addition.

s6-000-75d04a037362eabe.wav.text: You will read that RoPE has a long-term decay, that scores fall off with distance.

s6-001-d182e2e7095a43c9.wav.text: That claim is true and it is usually stated wrongly, so here is the measurement.

s6-002-b1864ca4f17543cf.wav.text: The flat line is two *independent* random vectors, and it is flat because it has to be: a rotation is an isometry, it preserves lengths and angles, so it cannot change the typical magnitude of a dot product between unrelated things.

s6-003-a5b94b498b389088.wav.text: Out to a gap of one hundred and twenty eight it is within one percent of where it started.

s6-004-65bbf5885e2977d2.wav.text: The green line is *matched* content — the same vector used as query and key, which is what a perfect content match looks like.

s6-005-05abb21014870708.wav.text: That one decays: one point zero at gap zero, zero point seven four at gap four, zero point four three at gap sixty four.

s6-006-775043cb90bef710.wav.text: And you can see exactly why from the formula: the score is a sum of cosines of m theta i, and as the gap grows those cosines drift out of phase with each other and stop reinforcing.

s6-007-f094c54406972298.wav.text: So the decay is real, and it is a soft prior on the *matched* case — not a cutoff, and not a general shrinking of every score.

s7-001-9bb2c42ccdcc5ffb.wav.text: One model configuration, four position schemes, identical seed, identical data, identical schedule.

s7-002-0e5493157859bc2b.wav.text: RoPE wins at one point zero two, and it costs zero parameters.

s7-003-7eec19b4d5648afc.wav.text: Learned positions, one point one one, and eight thousand parameters.

s7-004-bc7a83e4ea8866fe.wav.text: No positions at all, one point one two.

s7-005-7f3515716564d2e7.wav.text: And the sinusoidal table, one point one two — behind doing nothing.

s7-006-aca4de56de786af6.wav.text: Two things in that chart deserve saying out loud.

s7-007-cb6ef4053af54349.wav.text: First: no positions at all is not catastrophic, and it should not be, because a *causal* decoder leaks position for free.

s7-008-65333f14f3741051.wav.text: The token at index i can see exactly i plus one things, and the model can count them.

s7-009-ef15e824f89bbd1e.wav.text: Positional encoding sharpens a signal that already exists.

s7-010-86b14dd5296cd2d5.wav.text: In a bidirectional encoder its absence really is fatal.

s7-011-3590c991fc483919.wav.text: Second: the sinusoidal table landing behind nothing is not a bug, it is a warning about adding things to the residual stream, and that is the next scene.

s8-000-6634c0dc0d44eeeb.wav.text: Here is a bug we hit while building this, and I think it explains why the sinusoidal table has a worse reputation than the idea deserves.

s8-001-370d86e90e3d7a5d.wav.text: The raw table has entries between minus one and one.

s8-002-1f7f718bd5d114c4.wav.text: A GPT-2 style token embedding is initialised at a standard deviation of zero point zero two.

s8-003-4f273f63d9810969.wav.text: Add them straight together and the position signal is roughly fifty times louder than the token signal.

s8-004-65add80a432ae553.wav.text: Our very first measurement showed an initial loss *above* log of the vocabulary size, which is worse than guessing uniformly — because the logits were almost pure position with a whisper of token underneath.

s8-005-b5ee8ffc28c37915.wav.text: The original paper hides this by multiplying the embeddings by root d model instead of scaling the table down.

s8-007-5e084930f202966c.wav.text: We scale the table to match the embedding initialisation and we say so in the code.

s8-008-09ffd205d234e05d.wav.text: And notice what RoPE avoids by construction: it never touches the residual stream, so it can never compete with the token embeddings for the same coordinates.

s8-009-525974b2055cf6bb.wav.text: That is half of why it wins.

s9-000-dde92fad4b1c5a8e.wav.text: And here is the test a loss table cannot show you.

s9-001-41dc2b569ad411d0.wav.text: All three models were trained at a context of sixty four tokens.

s9-003-7da80445ba49be2b.wav.text: RoPE at sixty four, ninety six and one hundred and twenty eight: zero point eight eight, zero point eight one, zero point nine.

s9-005-95cbc1fee4c3c6cc.wav.text: The sinusoidal model: zero point nine nine, then one point two five, then one point seven two.

s9-006-a187df5888b2a088.wav.text: It degrades badly, but it *answers* — the table is defined for any position, so there is a number.

s9-007-a6ccddbd5553d909.wav.text: And the learned model has a bar of zero because the question cannot be asked.

s9-008-83b5c3ef6fe3ac99.wav.text: There is no row sixty five in its table.

s9-009-652d638d050789dd.wav.text: It is not that it does badly past its training length; it has no representation for a position it never saw.

s9-010-ea802c6f4632319e.wav.text: That is the practical difference, and it is why every long-context technique you will meet — position interpolation, NTK scaling, YaRN — is built on top of RoPE.

s9-011-59ed03545bbd5286.wav.text: They are all ways of stretching a rotation, and you cannot stretch a lookup table.
